name: AI Agents Decks
summary:
AI Agents Decks turns your Meta Quest into a command deck for AI coding agents.

Install the free Deck Host on your Mac, Windows PC or Linux machine (one line from aiagentsdecks.com), open AI Agents Decks, pick your computer and type the code it shows.

WHAT YOU GET
• The wall — every agent is a channel with a light: working, needs you, done, error or idle.
• Needs-you queue — permission prompts and finished work wait in one place.
• Real terminals — the agent's actual terminal, drawn sharp by the headset,
